reviews.title: Wasn't sure it would fit...It did...It's nice!
reviews.comment:
The rad is a good bit longer than a normal 360mm so be aware of this if you have a slightly smaller case. Just barely fit in the top of my case.  Didn't think not having the tubes hidden would make such a big difference, but it does. Performs nicely on my 7800x3d. The LCD is more than big enough. It's an AIO. It does it's job and looks good doing it.
Edit: The reviewer below me said this would not fit most cases and that couldn't be more false. Quit telling people crap if you don't know. I can assure you this AIO will fit MOST cases that have a spot for a 360MM rad. I have a smaller case front to back and was able to make this work just fine.  Only compromise I made was I was only to fasten to the case with 10 screws and not all 12. The design of this cooler does make the rad a little longer, but it WILL FIT MOST CASES that have spots for a 360mm radiator. I'm sure you can find the measurements you will need to figure this out if you question your own case.
reviews.author: Lisa

reviews.title: I love the design
reviews.comment: The aesthetics of the AIO are excellent, and the pipes can be handled and hidden very well. The LCD screen is a great addition, as I can now check temperatures without relying on Shadowplay statistics. The pump noise and temperatures are fine for my usage scenarios.
